description: Statistics Canada release calendar for The Daily: which surveys and indicators release on which date over the next ~two weeks. Use for "when is the next Labour Force Survey release", "when does StatCan publish the CPI / GDP / housing figures". Pass `query` (words from the release title, e.g. "Labour Force Survey") to filter; omit it for the whole window. Each row has the release date, title and reference period. The published window is about two weeks, so a release further out returns an empty list with a note, not a guess.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the release title (case-insensitive), e.g. "Labour Force Survey", "consumer price".

name: statcan_release_schedule
title: Statcan Release Schedule
